summary: controller profile with jog, pad, fader, eq, audio, usb, media, display diagnostic groups. Companion workflow(s): rekordbox,standalone.
identityNotes: Research seed; the manufacturer's XDJ-AZ Instruction Manual DRI1936C documents USB MIDI control (p. 129), a nominal 44.1 kHz audio section, a 32-bit MASTER D/A converter and 24-bit other A/D and D/A converters (p. 151). Nominal sampling and scoped converter resolutions do not establish a complete USB format/rate list or channel counts, which remain unknown. USB IDs, class compliance, DIN transport, receiving capability, Identity support, exact control maps, hardware/firmware revision, current OS/driver compatibility and physical performance remain unverified; no factory pass tolerances are inferred.

tests.title: Jog rotation and touch
tests.why: Check jog function on XDJ-AZ; avoid assumptions about HID or analog routing.
steps: Consult the exact XDJ-AZ manual for the relevant connectors and operating mode.
Exercise each jog element on the device and observe MIDI, HID/software response or audio measurement as applicable.
Check slow and fast transitions, all channels/sides, and repeats; save raw evidence and mark unobservable functions as not tested.
equipment: Compatible host software or capture interface when required

tests.title: Four-deck standalone playback and SonicLink
steps: Load reference music on all four standalone decks.
Measure analog master/booth routing and touchscreen navigation.
Pair compatible SonicLink headphones and check left/right monitoring separately from Bluetooth audio.
